mapper.delete: DELETE FROM docs_viewer_key WHERE delete_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP OR revoked_yn = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO docs_viewer_key ( disposable_key, object_type, object_id, file_no, file_name, user_cd, session_id, delete_at ) VALUES ( #{disposableKey}, #{objectType}, #{objectId}, #{fileNo}, #{fileName}, #{userCd}, #{sessionId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '15 minutes' )
